title: Get workshop-ready: your AI agent on your laptop · hancrafted
description: A step-by-step guide for first-timers on Mac, Windows or Linux: open your terminal, install and sign in to your AI agent, start it in the starter folder and run your first skill, so the workshop can begin right away.

Your terminal 0:00 – 0:09 Hook You have never opened a terminal. By the end of this page you will have run your first skill in one. 0:09 – 0:37 Why this page I split this into one step per screen, because a long setup guide feels like a wall and a single step feels like something you can finish. Every step hands you one thing that works and the next step needs it, so when you arrive at the workshop, we can start with a grilling session right away and nobody spends the first hour on setup.
Your AI agent 0:00 – 0:14 Terminal done So you now have a window that waits for words. Because an empty window cannot do much on its own, the next piece is the AI agent that will live inside it.

Your folder 0:00 – 0:17 Terminal and AI agent, now the place to work You have a terminal and an AI agent, so what is missing is a place to work. An AI agent works inside one folder and reads what is there, so we give it one on purpose: the starter folder.

Download and unzip the starter folder 0:00 – 0:24 One link, one zip There is one link to one zip file. Download it, and then unzip it. On a Mac, double-click the zip. On Windows, right-click it and choose Extract All. On Linux, use Extract here in your file manager. Inside you will find the files the workshop needs, already in place, so there is nothing to assemble. 0:24 – 0:37 Where it lives Take a second to notice where the folder landed, usually in your Downloads. The next step goes into exactly this folder, so if you remember where it is, the rest is easy.

Start the agent inside that folder 0:00 – 0:26 Go in, then start In your terminal you first move into the unzipped folder, and only then you start your AI agent. The page draws the terminal at each point, so you can check that the folder name appears in front of your cursor before you start. The AI agent may ask whether you trust this folder. For this one, you do, so say yes. 0:26 – 0:50 Same folder every time The order matters because an AI agent reads what is in the folder it starts in. That is how it will find your skill in a moment, and if you start it somewhere else, the skill is simply not there. So whenever you work with this starter folder, start the AI agent from inside it. 0:50 – 1:05 Chain so far Look at what you have. A terminal that waits, an AI agent inside it, and a folder it can read. One piece is left, and it is the one that proves all the others work.

Your first skill 0:00 – 0:17 Everything in place So everything is in place: a terminal, an AI agent and a folder. What is left is a skill, which is a small set of instructions your AI agent can follow, and running it shows that the chain is real.

The technical route 0:00 – 0:18 For people who build This last Section is for people who build, and it is optional. If you are comfortable with a terminal, you can get the same result without the starter folder by installing the pieces yourself. Everyone else can stop at the homepage.
